title: Avoid artifact-refusal writes on associated or concurrently changed observations
outcome: Only an exact still-unassociated observation snapshot can receive an artifact refusal; stale frames cannot reintroduce cleared diagnostics or disturb custody snapshots.
acceptance: Already associated and concurrently changed observations remain unchanged after stale artifact frames; original proof and whole-row authority fields remain intact.
A behavioral control proves the exact unassociated owner still receives a bounded diagnostic and genuine association clears it.
